acceptance_checks.check_id: A duplicate start carrying the same OperationId/fingerprint resolves to the existing operation/result/status rather than spawning a second side effect. Host deduplication/reconciliation must survive the reconnect/restart envelope claimed by that runtime.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: After an ambiguous/may-have-started result, callers reconcile the existing OperationId before considering a fresh OperationId for the same intended side effect. Automatic blind retry with a fresh OperationId is forbidden.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Cancellation targets OperationId and has explicit outcomes. cancel accepted/requested is not termination proof; execution remains live or unverifiable until authoritative host state reports exited with a cause. Disconnect during cancellation cannot be rewritten as cancelled/exited.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Canonical documents remain consistent with CAPABILITY_AND_GRANT_MODEL, IDENTITY_AND_REVISION_MODEL, ARCHITECTURE, PROTOCOL_STRATEGY, SECURITY_MODEL, QUALITY_AND_EVIDENCE, and the P01 task registry without preempting S04/S05.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Contact and execution states are separate closed vocabularies: contact connected|degraded|disconnected; execution live|exited|unverifiable. No rule maps disconnected or heartbeat timeout directly to exited.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Exact implementation passes focused state-machine, duplicate-operation, fingerprint-conflict, ambiguous-retry, cancellation, structured-error, and reconnect/revocation adversarial checks plus pnpm check, git diff --check, Diffcipline R3, protected exact-head CI, and post-merge main qualification.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Negotiation is explicit and provider-neutral. A RuntimeDescriptor binds exact Runtime identity plus protocol/capability support; unsupported, unknown, malformed, or unnegotiated mandatory capability/version fails closed rather than being inferred from runtime type.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Only authoritative execution-host observation may establish exited for host-owned execution. Reconciliation may change unverifiable to live or exited; stale controller observations cannot overwrite newer host generation/observation truth.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: OperationId is bound to a canonical operation fingerprint covering at least subject scope, exact action, canonical resource, Runtime ID, effective constraints, and semantic payload identity/digest. Reuse with a different fingerprint is an operation conflict and must not execute.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: RequestId identifies one protocol attempt. OperationId identifies one logical side-effecting operation across attempts/reconnects. Both obey canonical UUIDv7 validation, are non-secret identifiers, and neither grants authority.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Retry guidance has fail-closed semantics: safe same-attempt transport retry, reconcile-existing-operation, new-operation-only-after-definitely-not-started, or no-retry. Unknown retry safety defaults to reconcile/no automatic side effect.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Runtime revocation or Grant expiry blocks new admissions. Reconnect cannot reauthorize expired/revoked authority. Runtime identity continuity follows the proven identity model; changed enrolled trust identity requires a different Runtime identity.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Structured errors separate request failure from operation truth. Provider-neutral error code/category, retry guidance, correlation IDs, and side-effect certainty are explicit; foreign provider codes/messages cannot override canonical classification.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The negotiated capability set is an intersection. Advertisement is not authorization: S02 Grant/policy/host constraints remain mandatory, and provider/runtime names do not imply permission or feature availability.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical runtime-operation model, adversarial state/idempotency/cancellation/retry checks, bounded R3 slice proofs, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.
